purpose: Test whether native PRISM W adds out-of-sample value after frozen K/C on a separate real nonlinear system.

dataset.name: EMPS Electro-Mechanical Positioning System
dataset.citation: A. Janot, M. Gautier and M. Brunot, Data Set and Reference Models of EMPS, 2019 Workshop on Nonlinear System Identification Benchmarks.
dataset.split_rule: Official file-level split exposed by nonlinear_benchmarks.EMPS: DATA_EMPS for development, DATA_EMPS_PULSES for untouched test.

prediction_contract.sampling_time: read from consecutive t values and report without changing protocol
prediction_contract.support: origin t must provide the frozen maximum causal input history; official test state initialization rows are excluded mechanically

development_protocol.outer_oof: four deterministic expanding chronological folds over the official development file; boundaries are relative row quantiles 0.50/0.625/0.75/0.875/1.00 after common support
development_protocol.inner_selection: within each outer fit, nonzero candidates are selected by three deterministic expanding chronological validation folds using mean MSE
development_protocol.final_selection: repeat the same inner rule on the complete official development file, then fit exactly once on complete development
development_protocol.stage_admission: ACTIVE iff outer nested-OOF parent MSE minus child MSE exceeds epsilon_num; otherwise ZERO_IDENTITY

A.reason: The external experiment is preregistered to isolate W incremental value.

interpretation.zero_route: W correctly rejected on this task
interpretation.active_and_test_gain_nonpositive: W admission did not generalize on this task
